_readme: Single source of truth for the portfolio and the 'Ask my AI' assistant. The site renders ONLY facts with status 'confirmed'. Set status to 'confirmed' only when you can show evidence. Entries marked 'needs_confirmation' or 'unverified' stay in the file but are never rendered and never answer a chat question. Every fact must carry: id, claim, evidence_type (repo/demo/resume/none), link, status.

projects.name: Bank Customer Churn Prediction
projects.subtitle: Class Imbalance Benchmark & Recall Optimization
projects.problem: Skewed class distribution (20.4% churn) caused default classifiers to overlook exiting customers despite surface 94% accuracy (pre-fix notebook output).
projects.solution: SMOTE tested, undersampling tested, class weights tested, six classifiers compared.
projects.approach: GridSearchCV applied to the SVM, PCA used to visualise clusters in 2D.
projects.result: Achieved 0.87 recall on churned customers (pre-fix notebook output), identifying about 24 additional at-risk accounts compared to baseline models.
